applies_why: The judge text uses the absence of a statement naming whose body is the channel as the reason for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: the text names the seed of David 'according to the flesh' without naming whose body is the channel, so the point stays open.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.
room: The phrase 'a single verse does not state a link or its contrary' — I weighed reading one: non-statement can leave the point open for UNDERDETERMINED; reading two: non-statement is never a ground for UNDERDETERMINED. I used reading two.
why: The judge's reason for UNDERDETERMINED is that the text does not name whose body is the channel, which treats a non-statement as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED in violation of K-S2.
